gpt-4.basis: Architecture analysis (1.8T MoE), scaled from Bloom baseline with 1.3x system overhead.

gpt-4-turbo.basis: Estimated ~25% efficiency gain over GPT-4 base.

gpt-4o.basis: Scaled from Epoch AI benchmark (0.6 Wh/1k output) with 1.3x system overhead.

gpt-3.5-turbo.basis: Architecture analysis (~175B), aligned with optimized batching benchmarks.

claude-3-opus.basis: Latency-correlated scaling relative to GPT-4 Turbo.

gemini-1.5-pro.basis: MoE architecture proxy, aligned with GPT-4 Turbo compute intensity.

llama-3-70b.basis: Meta published training energy reverse-scaled for inference with 1.3x system overhead.
